cards.audioText: Your all sign is ACA517, Cruising at 10,100m, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO, make an initial contact with Guangzhou control.
cards.audioTextZh: 你的呼号是加航517，在10100米巡航，应答机3215，接近DAPRO，与广州区调进行初始联络。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, 10,100m maintaining, squawk 3215, approaching DAPRO.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，保持在10100米，应答机3215，接近DAPRO。

cards.audioText:
ACA517, radar identified.
There's moderate turbulence at 10,100m, ask if there's any turbulence at 10,700m.
cards.audioTextZh:
加航517，雷达识别。
[在10100米有中度颠簸，询问10700米是否有颠簸。]
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, we encountered moderate turbulence at 10,100m, confirm there is turbulence at 10,700m.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，我们在10100米遇到中度颠簸，证实10700米是否有颠簸。

cards.audioText:
ACA517, there's no turbulence at 10,700m.
Ask to climb to 10,700m due moderate turbulence.
cards.audioTextZh:
加航517，在10700米没有颠簸。
由于中度颠簸，请求爬升至10700米。
cards.referenceText: Request climb to 10,700m due moderate turbulence, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 由于中度颠簸，请求爬升至10700米，加航517。

cards.audioText: When you are at 10,700m, your left engine failed, make an urgency call and request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.audioTextZh: 当你在10700米时，你的左发失效了，做紧急呼叫，请求右转下降至6300米。
cards.referenceText: PANPAN, PANPAN, PANPAN, Guangzhou Control, ACA517, left engine failure, request turn right and descend to 6300m.
cards.referenceTextZh: PANPAN，PANPAN，PANPAN，广州区调，加航517，左发失效，请求右转下降到6300米。

cards.audioText: ACA517, turn right heading 200, descend to 6000m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，右转航向200，下降到6000米。
cards.referenceTextZh: 右转航向200，下降到6000米，加航517。

cards.audioText: Advise Guangzhou Control you want to divert to Wuhan airport, and track direct to WHA, and descend to lower level.
cards.audioTextZh: 告知广州区调，你想改航到武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降到更低高度。
cards.referenceText: Guangzhou Control, ACA517, request to divert to Wuhan and direct to WHA, descend to lower level.
cards.referenceTextZh: 广州区调，加航517，请求备降至武汉机场，直飞WHA，下降到更低高度。

cards.audioText: ACA517, turn left direct to WHA, descend to 2100m.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，左转直飞WHA，下降到2100米。
cards.referenceText: Turn left direct to WHA, descend to 2100m, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 左转直飞WHA，下降到2100米，加航517。

cards.audioText: The weather is deteriorating and is below landing minima, ask for ILS approach for runwy 36L.
cards.audioTextZh: 天气正在降级，已低于最低着陆标准，请求ILS进近，跑道36左。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Approach, ACA517, request ILS approach for runway 36L.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉进近，加航517，请求ILS进近，跑道36左。

cards.audioText: ACA517, runway 36L is not available, runway in use 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，跑道36左不可用，使用跑道36右。

cards.audioText: You executed missed approach procedure and try to land on runway 36R.
cards.audioTextZh: 你执行了复飞程序，想尝试在跑道36右着陆。
cards.referenceText: Wuhan Tower, ACA517, going around and we try to land on runway 36R.
cards.referenceTextZh: 武汉塔台，加航517，复飞了，我们尝试下在跑道36右着陆。

cards.audioText: ACA517, climb to 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure.
cards.audioTextZh: 加航517，爬升到1200米，按照标准复飞程序。
cards.referenceText: Climb to 1200m, follow standard missed approach procedure, ACA517.
cards.referenceTextZh: 爬升到1200米，按照标准复飞程序，加航517。
